# C02-03 — Audiences, brief, and voice

Status: verified

- Requirements: ST-003, ST-004, ST-006
- Evaluations: EV-006
- Inputs: confirmed intake, project-defined audiences, goals, messages, identity and channel constraints
- Output: explicit audiences and a brief with supported messages, objective, tone/voice by relevant audience, scope and success criteria
- Dependencies: C02-02, C01-01
- Acceptance: audiences and their piece-level tasks/CTAs are explicit; brief reflects confirmed context and variable audience counts; detected style or voice remains unapproved until confirmed
- Verification: 8 focused tests cover variable audience counts, stable IDs, message/source references, rejected/proposed audiences, tone/voice confirmation rules, cross-document integrity, and material review fields; independent review confirmed closure of all P1/P2 findings
- Limit: does not generate every audience/channel combination or approve detected identity automatically
